name: openxrypt
headline: OpenXrypt: Encrypted Messaging for Twitter &
short_description: OpenXrypt is a Chrome extension that encrypts direct messages on Twitter and WhatsApp Web using OpenPGP, protecting communication from unauthorized access and surveillance.
author: eddieoz

sections.overview:
OpenXrypt is a Chrome extension that adds OpenPGP encryption to direct messages on Twitter and WhatsApp Web, ensuring only sender and recipient can read message content. It automatically encrypts and decrypts messages while providing a user-friendly interface for managing GPG public and private keys locally in your browser. The extension supports group message encryption when all participants' public keys are registered, and includes timeline encryption features that allow you to post encrypted messages visible only to intended recipients. OpenXrypt solves the problem of unencrypted social media communication by enabling secure conversations without relying on platform-provided encryption, making it valuable for users concerned about privacy, data breaches, and unauthorized monitoring on social platforms.
Encrypt sensitive business communications over Twitter DMs
Protect personal conversations on WhatsApp Web from surveillance
Share encrypted messages in group chats on Twitter and WhatsApp
Post encrypted content to your timeline visible only to key holders
